liabilityItems: The CNC Calculator app is an auxiliary and educational tool only. All formulas, cutting parameter selections (Vc, fz, n, Vf), fit and ISO 2768 tables, seat and groove dimensions and generated hole coordinates (PCD) are provided AS IS.

Verification duty: the user (operator, programmer, process engineer) must always verify calculated values against the machine documentation, the cutting tool manufacturer data sheets and the part drawing.

No liability: the author and owner of the app accept no liability for any direct or indirect material damage, in particular machine collisions, spindle damage, broken tools, scrapped parts, production downtime or personal injury resulting from using the calculator results.
privacyItems: No personal data: the app requires no registration, no sign-in and no personal data.
Device local storage: all entered dimensions, the material inventory list and unit/language preferences are stored only locally in your browser. This data is never sent to external servers.

Cookieless Cloudflare analytics: the site uses anonymous Cloudflare Web Analytics. It sets no cookies, does not track users across sites and collects no IP addresses or device fingerprints. Only aggregated visit statistics (page views, country, browser type) are collected.
